title: A clear change invites reconsideration

captions.energy: Making a substantial distinction accessible together

meaning: Updating explanations through changed material can return your shared view to earlier experience when a substantial distinction becomes clear.
text: An actual change can offer a substantial reason to return. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Ajna updates understanding through changed material. The Sun in energy makes a substantial distinction accessible to both. Judgement in emotions feels called to reconsider experience. Your view can preserve earlier observations while examining what now needs another explanation, allowing a fresh question to have a definite subject without dismissing the work that came before.

Suppose you make a paper form from a thicker sheet. An earlier explanation of the fold no longer describes the resulting volume. You update it through visible thickness and differently meeting edges. **A clear change can return earlier experience to a fresh question.** You want to consider which relationships belonged to the old material and which changed. Your view gains an accessible connection between form and conditions. Returning has particular content. Earlier work need not become wrong or the new version better for the change to matter to both.

The risk is treating a call to reconsider as a need to explain every earlier action again. A clear change loses its scale. Wanting a distinction to be accessible preserves the subject. Thickness changed and some edges meet differently while other relationships may remain. Your view stays precise when observation grounds an update and returning refines a question without requiring the entire familiar method to be rewritten completely.
